I told Marcus in his #north-team thread that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is on **10 June**, not 25 November.

Ilse posted 25 November in #north-team on 14 Oct. Later that day she corrected it in #north-random, saying she had read the wrong line and the right date is 10 June. Marcus is a member of both channels, so he could already see the correction. A renewal date is account information, not a money figure, so it's fine to repeat it in #north-team.
